name: Tsuma ga Kirei ni Natta Wake
original_name: 妻が綺麗になったワケ
source:
I get the feeling that my wife has gotten more beautiful as of late.
It's a small thorn that's stuck in my side and just won't go away.
Niggling at my conscious that something may not be quite right.

After much deliberation, I hire a private detective to investigate
my wife's activities and I regret having ever thought of doing so...

You see, having learned of your wife's adulterous affair with another man
turned you on, made you burn bright with lust... like a horny beast.

You wish you never learnt this feeling but... at the same time you
wonder how you could have ever been satisfied without it...

NTR... A forbidden delicacy. The dark swirling lust within you beckons...
to draw you into a deep abyss, a never ending fall into cuckold depravity.

Enjoy... as your wife moans and groans in the throes of pleasure...
... with another man.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE197014.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
最近，我总觉得妻子变漂亮了。
这种感觉就像一根小刺扎在身上，怎么也无法消失，始终提醒着我，也许有什么地方不对劲。

经过一番犹豫，我雇了私家侦探调查妻子的行踪，却后悔自己曾经做过这个决定……

原来，得知妻子与另一个男人偷情，竟让我兴奋不已，欲火熊熊燃烧，像一头发情的野兽。

我希望自己从未了解过这种感觉……可与此同时，又想不明白没有它我过去究竟是如何满足的……

NTR……一种禁忌的美味。你心中暗自翻涌的欲望，正召唤你坠入一场深不见底、永无止境的绿帽堕落深渊。

尽情享受吧……看着妻子在另一个男人身下发出呻吟与喘息……
